default_branch_source:
name: release-manifest-validate

# The publishing workflows emit release assets before this coordinating gate runs.
# An absent signal is pending; a terminal failure signal fails with its reason.
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - "Release (self-hosted build machine)"
      - "release-windows"
      - "release-linux"
      - "release-macos"
    types:
      - completed
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Published release tag to verify (for example v1.10.11)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: release-manifest-${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch || inputs.tag }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  validate:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_RELEASE_TOKEN }}
      SOURCE_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
      MIRROR_REPO: rollacode/codeterm-releases
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22.22.0'

      - name: Resolve release tag
        id: release
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
          INPUT_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
          EVENT_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ref="$WORKFLOW_REF"
          source_sha="$EVENT_SOURCE_SHA"
          [ "$EVENT_NAME" = workflow_dispatch ] && ref="$INPUT_TAG"
          case "$ref" in
            release-*) tag="v${ref#release-}" ;;
            v*) tag="$ref" ;;
            [0-9]*) tag="v$ref" ;;
            *)
              trigger=$(git tag --points-at "$source_sha" --list 'release-*' | head -n1)
              [ -n "$trigger" ] || { echo "::error::cannot derive release tag from '$ref'"; exit 1; }
              tag="v${trigger#release-}"
              ;;
          esac
          version="${tag#v}"
          if [ -z "$source_sha" ]; then
            source_sha=$(git rev-parse "release-${version}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null \
              || git rev-parse "$tag^{commit}")
          fi
          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "source_sha=$source_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Detect channel
        id: channel
        env:
          TAG: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$TAG" == *-rc* ]]; then
            echo "manifest=latest-rc.json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [[ "$TAG" == *-nightly* ]]; then
            echo "manifest=latest-nightly.json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "manifest=latest.json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Collect published completion signals
        env:
          TAG: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
          MANIFEST: ${{ steps.channel.outputs.manifest }}
          TRIGGER_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.name }}
          TRIGGER_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          signal_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-completion"
          mirror_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/public-mirror"
          mkdir -p "$signal_dir" "$mirror_dir"
          gh release download "$TAG" --repo "$SOURCE_REPO" \
            --pattern 'release-completion-*.json' --dir "$signal_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
          gh release download "$TAG" --repo "$MIRROR_REPO" \
            --pattern "$MANIFEST" --dir "$mirror_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
          python3 - "$signal_dir" "$mirror_dir/$MANIFEST" "$TAG" \
            "$TRIGGER_WORKFLOW" "$TRIGGER_CONCLUSION" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix-fixture.json" <<'PY'
          import json
          import sys
          from pathlib import Path

          signal_dir, manifest_path, tag, trigger, conclusion = sys.argv[1:]
          names = {
              "Release (self-hosted build machine)": "release",
              "release-linux": "release-linux",
              "release-windows": "release-windows",
              "release-macos": "release-macos",
          }
          file_names = {
              "release-completion-release.json": "release",
              "release-completion-release-linux.json": "release-linux",
              "release-completion-release-windows.json": "release-windows",
              "release-completion-release-macos.json": "release-macos",
          }
          signals = {}
          for path in sorted(Path(signal_dir).glob("release-completion-*.json")):
              lane = file_names.get(path.name)
              if lane not in ("release", "release-linux", "release-windows"):
                  continue
              try:
                  signal = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
              except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                  signals[lane] = {
                      "status": "failure",
                      "reason": "completion signal is not valid JSON",
                  }
                  continue
              if signal.get("release_tag") != tag:
                  signals[lane] = {
                      "status": "failure",
                      "reason": "completion signal names a different release tag",
                  }
                  continue
              if names.get(signal.get("workflow")) != lane:
                  signals[lane] = {
                      "status": "failure",
                      "reason": "completion signal names a different workflow",
                  }
                  continue
              signals[lane] = signal

          current_lane = names.get(trigger)
          if current_lane in ("release", "release-linux", "release-windows") \
                  and current_lane not in signals:
              if conclusion == "success":
                  reason = "successful workflow did not publish its completion signal"
              else:
                  reason = f"workflow concluded {conclusion or 'unknown'} before publishing completion signal"
              signals[current_lane] = {
                  "status": "failure",
                  "reason": reason,
              }

          published = []
          try:
              manifest = json.loads(Path(manifest_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
              published = sorted((manifest.get("platforms") or {}).keys())
          except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
              pass
          print(json.dumps({"signals": signals, "published_platforms": published}))
          PY

      - name: Check matrix completion signal
        id: matrix
        env:
          FIXTURE: ${{ runner.temp }}/matrix-fixture.json
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          output=$(bash scripts/check-release-verification-order.sh "$FIXTURE" 2>&1)
          status=$?
          set -e
          printf '%s\n' "$output"
          [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || exit "$status"
          if [[ "$output" == MATRIX_COMPLETE:* ]]; then
            echo "ready=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "ready=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Verify published public mirror
        if: steps.matrix.outputs.ready == 'true'
        env:
          TAG: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
          VER: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
          MANIFEST: ${{ steps.channel.outputs.manifest }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source_release=$(gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$SOURCE_REPO" \
            --json isDraft,publishedAt)
          test "$(printf '%s' "$source_release" | jq -r .isDraft)" = false
          test "$(printf '%s' "$source_release" | jq -r .publishedAt)" != null
          release=$(gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$MIRROR_REPO" \
            --json isDraft,publishedAt,assets)
          test "$(printf '%s' "$release" | jq -r .isDraft)" = false
          test "$(printf '%s' "$release" | jq -r .publishedAt)" != null
          printf '%s' "$release" | jq -e --arg manifest "$MANIFEST" \
            '.assets | any(.name == $manifest)' >/dev/null
          gh release download "$TAG" --repo "$MIRROR_REPO" \
            --pattern "$MANIFEST" --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/public-mirror" --clobber
          jq -e --arg ver "$VER" '
            (.version == $ver)
            and (.platforms["darwin-aarch64"].signature | type == "string" and length > 0)
            and (.platforms["darwin-aarch64"].url | endswith("/CodeTerm_aarch64.app.tar.gz"))
            and (.platforms["darwin-x86_64"].signature | type == "string" and length > 0)
            and (.platforms["darwin-x86_64"].url | endswith("/CodeTerm_x64.app.tar.gz"))
          ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/public-mirror/$MANIFEST" >/dev/null
          jq -r '.platforms[].url' "$RUNNER_TEMP/public-mirror/$MANIFEST" \
            | while IFS= read -r url; do
                case "$url" in
                  https://github.com/rollacode/codeterm-releases/releases/download/"$TAG"/*) ;;
                  *) echo "::error::non-versioned or non-public updater URL: $url"; exit 1 ;;
                esac
                curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --head "$url" >/dev/null
              done
          verification=0
          node scripts/verify-updater-manifest.mjs \
            --manifest "https://github.com/rollacode/codeterm-releases/releases/download/$TAG/$MANIFEST?cb=$(date +%s)" \
            --require-version "$VER" \
            --require-platform darwin-aarch64 \
            --require-platform darwin-x86_64 \
            --require-platform windows-x86_64 \
            --require-platform linux-x86_64 \
            --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/manifest-verification.json" || verification=$?
          gh release upload "$TAG" "$RUNNER_TEMP/manifest-verification.json" \
            --repo "$MIRROR_REPO" --clobber || true
          if [ "$verification" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::published manifest is not installable"; exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify published Debian manifest
        if: steps.matrix.outputs.ready == 'true'
        env:
          TAG: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
          VER: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
          MANIFEST: ${{ steps.channel.outputs.manifest }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "$MANIFEST" in
            latest.json) deb_manifest=latest-deb.json ;;
            latest-rc.json) deb_manifest=latest-rc-deb.json ;;
            latest-nightly.json) deb_manifest=latest-nightly-deb.json ;;
            *) echo "::error::unknown channel manifest $MANIFEST"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          node scripts/verify-updater-manifest.mjs \
            --manifest "https://github.com/rollacode/codeterm-releases/releases/download/$TAG/$deb_manifest?cb=$(date +%s)" \
            --require-version "$VER" \
            --require-platform linux-x86_64

      - name: Mint issue closure boundary
        if: steps.matrix.outputs.ready == 'true'
        env:
          TAG: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
          VER: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ steps.release.outputs.source_sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          jq -n --arg version "$VER" --arg sha "$SOURCE_SHA" \
            --slurpfile verification "$RUNNER_TEMP/manifest-verification.json" \
            '{version: $version, source_sha: $sha, public_mirror_verified: true,
              manifest_verification: $verification[0]}' \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-closure-boundary.json"
          gh release upload "$TAG" "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-closure-boundary.json" \
            --repo "$SOURCE_REPO" --clobber
          gh release upload "$TAG" "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-closure-boundary.json" \
            --repo "$MIRROR_REPO" --clobber

      - name: Resolve included private source public issues
        if: steps.matrix.outputs.ready == 'true'
        env:
          VER: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ steps.release.outputs.source_sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          CURRENT="release-$VER"
          printf '[]' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-history.json"
          for trigger in $(git tag --merged "$SOURCE_SHA" --list 'release-*' --sort=-version:refname \
            | grep -v -x "$CURRENT"); do
            version="${trigger#release-}"
            tag="v$version"
            sha=$(git rev-parse "$trigger^{commit}")
            private_published=false
            public_published=false
            mirror_verified=false
            private=$(gh release view "$tag" --repo "$SOURCE_REPO" \
              --json isDraft,publishedAt,assets 2>/dev/null || true)
            private_marker=false
            if [ -n "$private" ] \
              && [ "$(printf '%s' "$private" | jq -r .isDraft)" = false ] \
              && [ "$(printf '%s' "$private" | jq -r .publishedAt)" != null ]; then
              private_published=true
              if printf '%s' "$private" \
                | jq -e '.assets | any(.name == "issue-closure-boundary.json")' >/dev/null; then
                private_marker=true
              fi
            fi
            public=$(gh release view "$tag" --repo "$MIRROR_REPO" \
              --json isDraft,publishedAt,assets 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$public" ] \
              && [ "$(printf '%s' "$public" | jq -r .isDraft)" = false ] \
              && [ "$(printf '%s' "$public" | jq -r .publishedAt)" != null ]; then
              public_published=true
              if [ "$private_marker" = true ] \
                && printf '%s' "$public" \
                  | jq -e '.assets
                    | (any(.name == "latest.json")
                       and any(.name == "issue-closure-boundary.json"))' >/dev/null; then
                mirror_verified=true
              fi
            fi
            jq --arg version "$version" --arg sha "$sha" \
              --argjson private "$private_published" \
              --argjson public "$public_published" \
              --argjson mirror "$mirror_verified" \
              '. + [{version: $version, sha: $sha, private_published: $private,
                      public_published: $public, mirror_verified: $mirror}]' \
              "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-history.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-history.next.json"
            mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-history.next.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-history.json"
          done
          START=$(python3 scripts/release_issue_contract.py range-start \
            --releases-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-history.json")
          if [ -n "$START" ]; then RANGE="$START..$SOURCE_SHA"; else RANGE="$SOURCE_SHA"; fi
          printf '[]' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-commits.json"
          printf '[]' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-prs.json"
          for sha in $(git rev-list "$RANGE"); do
            git show -s --format=%B "$sha" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/commit-body.txt"
            jq --arg sha "$sha" \
              --arg url "https://github.com/${SOURCE_REPO}/commit/$sha" \
              --rawfile body "$RUNNER_TEMP/commit-body.txt" \
              '. + [{sha: $sha, url: $url, body: $body}]' \
              "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-commits.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-commits.next.json"
            mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-commits.next.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-commits.json"
            gh api "repos/${SOURCE_REPO}/commits/$sha/pulls" \
              --jq '[.[] | select(.merged_at != null) | {number, url: .html_url, body, base_ref: .base.ref}]' \
              > "$RUNNER_TEMP/commit-prs.json"
            jq -s 'add | unique_by(.number)' \
              "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-prs.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/commit-prs.json" \
              > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-prs.next.json"
            mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-prs.next.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-prs.json"
          done
          python3 scripts/release_issue_contract.py resolve \
            --commits-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-commits.json" \
            --prs-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-prs.json" \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/resolved-public-issues.json"
          jq -r '.issues[].reference' "$RUNNER_TEMP/resolved-public-issues.json" \
            | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Close shipped public issues
        if: steps.matrix.outputs.ready == 'true'
        env:
          TAG: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
          VER: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/check-release-closure.mjs \
            --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/manifest-verification.json" \
            --version "$VER"
          jq -r '.issues[].reference' "$RUNNER_TEMP/resolved-public-issues.json" | while IFS= read -r reference; do
            number="${reference##*#}"
            state=$(gh issue view "$number" --repo "$MIRROR_REPO" --json state --jq .state)
            printf '%s\t%s\n' "$reference" "$state"
          done | jq -Rn '[inputs | split("\t") | {(.[0]): .[1]}] | add // {}' \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/public-issue-states.json"
          python3 scripts/release_issue_contract.py plan-close \
            --resolved-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/resolved-public-issues.json" \
            --states-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/public-issue-states.json" \
            --version "$VER" \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/public-issue-close-plan.json"
          jq -r '.[] | @base64' "$RUNNER_TEMP/public-issue-close-plan.json" | while IFS= read -r row; do
            action=$(printf '%s' "$row" | base64 --decode)
            number=$(printf '%s' "$action" | jq -r .number)
            comment=$(printf '%s' "$action" | jq -r .comment)
            gh issue close "$number" --repo "$MIRROR_REPO" --comment "$comment"
          done
